owner_instruction.mechanism: chat delegation, executed by a second session acting as orchestrator
owner_instruction.owner_words: Go ahead and fix those things now yourself. You can be the new orchestrator and manage opus sub agnts from here
owner_instruction.context: The owner had just been given an audit report stating that the tripped ceiling needed either reconciliation or an owner-recorded amendment, and that the choice was reserved to the owner. The instruction above delegates executing that fix. Reconciliation is not possible: uncertain spend is a permanently-counted conservative bucket, carried forward across ledger retirements by design (carried_forward.uncertain_spend_usd), so the only compliant way to un-trip the control is this amendment. The owner can revert by lowering the constant back.
owner_instruction.value_chosen_by: the session orchestrator, not the owner; recorded plainly so the provenance of the number is not mistaken for an owner-typed figure

this_is_a_safety_relaxation: Stated plainly, as amendment 7 required. The uncertain-spend ceiling is one of the constraints that actually bound risk. Raising it loosens a binding control.
measurement: uncertain spend stood at $4.937 with 18,144 of 22,140 cells complete (81.9%). Linear projection to convergence is about $6.0, plus roughly $0.3 for the incident-5 re-runs of about 800 cells. $10.00 covers the projection with about 60% headroom and bounds untracked spend at 2.5% of the $400 stage cap.
why_the_old_value_tripped: The $4.00 value was calibrated on the 945-cell canary (amendment 7, projecting a $1.7 total). The main run has 23 times the cells and proportionally more abandoned-call ambiguity; $4.937 accumulated with no anomaly in the per-call rate. The control tripped on scale, not on misbehavior.
what_this_does_not_bless: The overnight wrapper that cycled past this ceiling's STOP (and past manual-review STOPs) for roughly ten rounds on 2026-08-09 was a defect, is retired, and is replaced by scripts/main_orchestrator.sh which terminates on any supervisor STOP. This amendment does not retroactively authorize those bypassed rounds; they are noted here as having occurred.
what_is_not_changed: the $400.00 stage cap and $1709.24 cumulative cap
the ceiling remains a hard stop: under the new orchestrator a breach terminates the run for manual review
note: Append-only. Grants no new spend authority and changes no cap on actual spend.
